survivors.title: Bellows Bench
survivors.pitch: The phone becomes the tool — the machine plate unlocks the exact manual page for jewelry workshops: piece tracking minutes after the work happens, auto-makes a 30-second recap the owner will repost.

survivors.title: Bushing for plumbing crews
survivors.pitch: Give plumbing crews site photos become daily logs with warnings: job photos and invoices in minutes instead of days, ends in printed QR cards for the wall.

verdicts.attack: Voice transcription in noisy jewelry workshops may be unreliable
verdicts.why: Strongest: unique use case with clear time savings and social media value

verdicts.attack: Counter cameras in poultry farms may not capture all relevant mortality data
verdicts.why: Good but less defensible time savings than Bellows Bench

verdicts.attack: QR cards may not provide enough value over digital records
verdicts.why: Strongest: solves real pain point in documentation workflow

verdicts.attack: Electrical code reference already exists in many forms
verdicts.why: Too generic, unlikely to provide significant new value
